meta.title: Mentorship, Higher Education and Career Readiness Survey — Northern Ghana
meta.subtitle: University for Development Studies, Tamale - Ghana
meta.description: This short survey is for final-year students and recent graduates from Northern Ghana. It aims to understand access to mentorship and how mentorship may relate to motivation, readiness for postgraduate education, and job-market preparation. Participation is voluntary. Please do not include your name or other identifying details. Responses will be used to understand needs and plan possible support. Most people should complete this in about 3 minutes.

q2.title: Which part of Northern Ghana are you mainly from or based in?

q3.title: Which school or tertiary institution do/did you attend?
q3.help: Please enter the name of your current or most recently attended institution.

q4.title: Which best describes your current status?
options: Recent graduate (graduated within the last 3 years)

q5.title: What is your current or most recently completed level of education?

q6.title: If you are currently doing a final-year or major research project, how difficult is it?
q6.help: Rate from 1 to 10, where 1 = not difficult at all and 10 = extremely difficult. Leave blank if this does not apply to you.

q7.title: How much access have you had to useful mentorship for your education or career?
options: I tried to find a mentor but could not
Very limited — one or two conversations

q8.title: To what extent do you agree that mentorship can help people from Northern Ghana progress to postgraduate education and become job-market ready?

q9.title: Which best describes your postgraduate or further-education situation?
options: Currently enrolled in postgraduate / further education
Plan or hope to apply, but have not yet applied
Would like to continue, but face barriers
Not currently interested in further education

q10.title: What kind of mentorship or support would be most useful to you?
options: Choosing a postgraduate programme or career path
Preparing applications, CVs or personal statements
Research skills and final-year project support

q11.title: What are the main barriers you face in accessing postgraduate education or becoming job-ready?

q12.title: Is there one specific kind of mentorship or opportunity you wish you had access to?

q13.title: If an organisation offered voluntary mentorship and guidance to help people access postgraduate education and prepare for the job market, how would you feel about taking part?
q13.help: There is no right or wrong answer. Please choose the response that best reflects your current view.
options: I am unsure and would need more information
I would probably not be interested
It would depend on the type of support offered
